mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a popular term in today‟s business vocabulary."
Corporation social responsibility is a popular term in today‟s business vocabulary.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an exclusive preserve of the federal comment."
Cooperative legislation is an exclusive preserve of the federal comment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the tenets of corporate administration."
The agency principle is one of the tenets of corporate administration.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a retail organisation in which the consumers are members who provide the capital and share the trading profits in the form of dividend on purchases made by each member."
A cooperative society is a retail organisation in which the consumers are members who provide the capital and share the trading profits in the form of dividend on purchases made by each member.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a body of politicians representing particular territories or interests."
The legislature is a body of politicians representing particular territories or interests.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the law regulating the affairs of the cooperative societies."
Cooperative law is concerned with the law regulating the affairs of the cooperative societies.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the evaluation of alternative economic situations (states, configurations) from the point of view of the society‟s well-being."
Welfare economics is concerned with the evaluation of alternative economic situations (states, configurations) from the point of view of the society‟s well-being.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an elusive concept in as much as the power of direction of a company can rarely be sharply segregated."
Control is an elusive concept in as much as the power of direction of a company can rarely be sharply segregated.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a liability owed to creditors."
Loan capital is a liability owed to creditors.

contract

voidable contract

legal person
